population: All explicitly dated P3 succession, imperial_succession, regime_change and institutional_change relationship records in the existing 1762–1800 world pilot; not a representative sample of Europe

reviewed_links.caveat: The P3 source-backed France 1774 succession record names two persons and their separate source-dated roles. Neither day-level simultaneity nor an accession mechanism is inferred.
The source describes succession in the elective imperial office, not inheritance or control of every HRE polity. The source records preserve original year precision.
The P3 transition and P2 institution role sources are separate: this links an exiting collegial executive to the new institutional system without inventing a single personal ruler.
